capabilities: Correct double-capital words as they are typed
Capitalize sentence beginnings and list/task items
Exclude words and folders from correction
Pause and resume auto correction via a command
Skip protected text such as code, math, links and email addresses
disambiguation: Not a spellchecker; it only fixes double-capital words and applies optional sentence/list capitalization rules.
extras: Correction only fires for words typed character by character in the current editor; pasted text, programmatic edits, IME composition, mobile keyboards and swipe input are deliberately left uncorrected. Additional test and acceptance docs live in tests/README.md and docs/OBSIDIAN_ACCEPTANCE.md.
problem: Obsidian does not correct double-capital typos as you type, and naive correction would damage code, links, URLs and addresses.

relations.evidence: CodeMirror applies the delimiter and correction in one transaction, preserving selection mapping and normal undo grouping.

summary: Typing-time autocorrect that fixes double initial capitals (HAllo → Hallo), with optional rules to capitalize sentences and list items.
